query: I made a pricing policy but my preemptible job still won't start on it — why?
expected_behavior: Reads the policy with nebius billing pricing-policy get and checks status.scheduling_state
Explains SCHEDULING_STATE_BLOCKED = the bid is below the current spot price, so it backs nothing until the market drops or the bid is raised
Offers to raise the bid via pricing-policy update --pricing-max-price-v1-max-price (Tier B, gated), noting the bid can only change while no VM runs under the policy (else FAILED_PRECONDITION)
Confirms the policy's platform matches the job's --platform (a policy caps exactly one platform)
Does not run delete or edit/edit-by-name
